discovery_sources: Google Scholar citation and related-work graph
saturation_criteria: Each RMC has at least one same-field mechanism query and one real cross-domain Academic Bridge query
Recovered domains expose their own terminology for the target relation rather than only target-domain words
At least two non-duplicate strong Source Problem-Intervention pairs per RMC are available for full-text causal screening, or the domain is explicitly closed for lack of credible isomorphism
Search distinguishes intervention efficacy and boundary evidence from algorithm-name or task similarity

required_mechanism_changes.failed_relation_state_or_information_str: Safely observed pose, wrench and instantaneous motion are mapped through a calibration-fixed or prediction-accuracy-oriented contact representation that aliases histories and finite-area conditions whose future wrench capacity and optimal impedance actions differ.
required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Replace that representation relation with a minimal action-conditional contact-capacity state or set that retains a history, geometry, tangential or uncertainty distinction only when it changes feasible normal-tangential gains, fallback, or held-out joint outcomes, and calibrate its coverage under the declared shifts.
required_mechanism_changes.change_direction: FROM prediction-sufficient point state that may alias gain-relevant conditions TO calibrated decision-sufficient action-conditional capacity state or set with explicit abstention outside supported coverage
required_mechanism_changes.causal_position: Between safely obtainable observation history and the impedance-selection variables, before gain choice and constraint evaluation
required_mechanism_changes.activation_condition: Held-out material, relaxation, finite-area geometry, friction, speed, dwell or loading history makes two currently aliased observation histories imply non-equivalent future capacity or impedance actions
required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: This directly repairs the diagnosed state-to-action aliasing relation while rejecting extra variables that improve model fit but do not change feasible actions or outcomes.

required_mechanism_changes.failed_relation_state_or_information_str: Performance-oriented normal-tangential gain selection is computed separately from contact capacity, interaction energy, actuator and gain-rate reachability, deadline, infeasibility and deterministic fallback, so post-hoc guards can change or invalidate the intended action.
required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Make the realized impedance action the output of one update-time feasibility relation in which performance, capacity, interaction-energy, actuator, gain-rate, computation deadline, infeasibility and fallback jointly determine selection rather than sequentially correcting an independently optimized gain.
required_mechanism_changes.change_direction: FROM performance-first gain proposal followed by separate safety projection or fallback TO one total update-time decision relation whose feasible action and fallback are jointly conditioned on all physical, energetic and computational limits
required_mechanism_changes.causal_position: At the impedance decision and realization interface, before a new gain is rendered by the inner loop
required_mechanism_changes.activation_condition: A candidate gain lies near contact or wrench capacity, interaction-energy, actuator, gain-rate or solve-time boundaries where a separated guard would alter, delay or reject it
required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: This directly repairs the diagnosed selection-feasibility decoupling and permits a decisive comparison against post-hoc guards using realized-action equivalence.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Compress observation history into distinctions sufficient for impedance action and outcome equivalence rather than generic contact reconstruction.
Represent action-conditional future wrench, slip or moment capacity and uncertainty with empirically checkable held-out coverage and abstention.
Choose coupled normal-tangential stiffness and damping only from actions jointly feasible for contact, energy, actuator and gain-rate limits.
Return a deterministic feasible action or declared fallback within every update deadline, with timeout and infeasibility counted as decisions.

target_mechanism_signatures.domain_neutral_failure_structure: A nominal decision is optimized for performance using uncertain parameters, then a separate shield, projection or scheduler alters it when hard feasibility is checked, breaking the nominal decision-outcome relation.
target_mechanism_signatures.causal_or_computational_variable_or_rela: Coupling between decision variables, uncertain constraint capacity, resource feasibility and a total fallback policy

target_mechanism_signatures.required_intervention: Produce the realized action from one feasibility-aware decision relation that internalizes uncertain physical constraints and computation/fallback availability

domain_hypotheses.domain_or_research_community_or_paradigm: Decision-focused learning, value-equivalent models, predictive-state representations and task-oriented compression
domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: These communities study which environmental distinctions must be preserved because they change a downstream policy, value or optimization decision, rather than because they reduce generic prediction error.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: High-dimensional or partially observed histories contain distinctions irrelevant to decision quality and others whose aliasing changes actions or regret.
domain_hypotheses.expected_intervention_family: Decision-loss training, value-equivalent compression, predictive sufficient statistics or action-conditional set prediction

domain_hypotheses.domain_or_research_community_or_paradigm: Predictive safety filters, runtime assurance, feasibility-aware predict-then-optimize and robust constrained control
domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: These communities study how a nominal performance action, uncertain constraint parameters and a certified backup or fallback can be made one recursively feasible real-time decision.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: Nominal actions become unsafe or unavailable when constraints, uncertainty or computation are checked only after optimization.
domain_hypotheses.expected_intervention_family: Predictive feasible-set filtering, feasibility-aware decision loss, recursive feasibility with terminal safe sets, or total runtime-assurance selection

domain_hypotheses.domain_or_research_community_or_paradigm: Value-equivalent modeling and value-equivalent sampling in model-based reinforcement learning
domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: The source community treats model distinctions as necessary only when they change Bellman updates, values, policies or regret, matching the target failure in which prediction-equivalent contact histories require different impedance actions.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: A detailed predictive model expends capacity on distinctions irrelevant to downstream planning while potentially losing distinctions that change decisions.
domain_hypotheses.expected_intervention_family: Value-equivalent model classes, policy/value-function scoped Bellman equivalence and rate-distortion value-equivalent sampling

domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: This community changes the prediction-learning relation so errors are weighted by downstream objective, constraint, infeasibility or regret rather than generic prediction accuracy.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: Predicted parameters appear inside a downstream constrained optimization problem, and statistically accurate predictions can still yield poor or infeasible decisions.
domain_hypotheses.expected_intervention_family: SPO loss, decision loss, feasibility-aware decision-focused learning and end-to-end predict-then-optimize

domain_hypotheses.domain_or_research_community_or_paradigm: Hamilton-Jacobi reachability safe learning and predictive safety filtering
domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: The source problem explicitly separates an arbitrary nominal action from a certified safe action under uncertain dynamics, making it a high-value structural comparator for deciding whether supervisory filtering truly matches or fails the target RMC.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: A nominal performance policy can leave a robust controlled-invariant set when dynamics or confidence differ from the model.
domain_hypotheses.expected_intervention_family: Least-restrictive safety supervisor, predictive safety filter, terminal safe set, recursive feasibility and confidence-triggered backup

domain_hypotheses.domain_or_research_community_or_paradigm: Control barrier function and control Lyapunov function quadratic programs
domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: This community places performance, invariant-set safety and actuator limits in the optimization that produces the applied action, potentially matching the target intervention more closely than a separate safety supervisor.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: A performance control objective must be realized without leaving a forward-invariant safe set under input limits.
domain_hypotheses.expected_intervention_family: CLF-CBF-QP, zeroing control barrier functions, soft performance constraints and hard safety constraints

domain_hypotheses.domain_or_research_community_or_paradigm: Calibrated robust contextual optimization and smart predict-then-optimize with uncertain constraints
domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: The source problem learns context-conditioned uncertain objective or constraint parameters but evaluates and calibrates them through the robust feasible decisions they induce, matching the target need to turn contact observations into capacity sets used inside optimal impedance selection.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: Point predictions can be accurate on average yet induce infeasible or risk-misaligned downstream decisions when uncertain parameters define constraints.
domain_hypotheses.expected_intervention_family: Predict-then-calibrate uncertainty sets, robust contextual optimization, feasibility-aware decision loss and smart robust-constraint surrogates

domain_hypotheses.domain_or_research_community_or_paradigm: Anytime heuristic search and deadline-bounded planning
domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: The source problem must return an executable feasible decision under a hard deliberation budget, and its intervention maintains a feasible incumbent while monotonically improving quality until interruption; this directly matches deadline-total impedance selection better than a safety supervisor.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: Exact optimization may exceed the action deadline, while returning no solution or an infeasible partial iterate is unacceptable.
domain_hypotheses.expected_intervention_family: Fast feasible incumbent, monotone anytime refinement, explicit suboptimality bound and deadline interruption
